name: Converter
description: Unit converter and a calculator that remembers its history.

changelog.1.0.0: First release: ten unit categories, calculator with history and 'ans'.
changelog.1.0.1: Now says what it can do (permissions: shown before you install, enforced while it runs), is listed in the new categories, and handles Ctrl+C and command-line arguments cleanly.
changelog.1.1.0: New: fuel economy, currencies (live rates, with saved and built-in rates for offline use), number bases, cooking measures (cups to grams) and oven gas marks; favourites; copy the result to the clipboard.
